name: SoundCloud
description: Search SoundCloud, open its tracks, sets and artists from a link, and acquire the tracks it streams in full.
about: SoundCloud adds SoundCloud to Songstress's search: tracks, sets and artists, beside your library and your other sources. A soundcloud.com link, a short on.soundcloud.com one included, opens as its page.
Tracks SoundCloud streams in full can be **acquired** into your library, once an admin turns that on. A preview is never taken for the whole song.
useCases: Find a DJ mix, a remix or a live set that other catalogues don't carry.
Open a SoundCloud link someone sent you.
Keep a set's tracks in your own library.
howItWorks: Your server reads soundcloud.com once for the client id its site uses, keeps it, and asks SoundCloud's API with it, so a search doesn't fetch the site each time. It needs no SoundCloud account.
Playing and downloading reach the servers SoundCloud's audio streams from, and are off until an admin turns them on. Its results sit beside Songstress's own sources, never in their place.
